In bilateral or decentralized systems without an online trusted arbiter or tamper-proof tamper-resistant hardware, it is logically impossible to guarantee absolute fairness for both parties simultaneously. If one party stops cooperating midway, the protocol cannot unilaterally force delivery of the asset without giving one side an unfair advantage or the ability to cheat. PaperRail relies on cryptographic paper trails rather than an active arbiter, leaving it vulnerable to this impossibility theorem.
